item.title: Commission proposes Quantum Act and new Sovereign Tech Equity Fund to strengthen Europe's industrial capacity and security
item.description: European Commission Press release Strasbourg, 25 Nov 2026 The European Commission today proposed the Quantum Act, a new framework to help turn Europe's quantum research into products and services, strengthen supply chains and prepare Europe's digital systems for post-quantum cryptography. The proposal also lays the groundwork for the Sovereign Tech Equity Fund (STEF).
